build_GLA5_config_from_yaml: build a GLACanonConfig from a YAML args object for GLA5 model variants with canon layers
load_from_lingua_state: load Lingua checkpoint state dict into a GLACanonForCausalLM model and map key prefixes
from_pretrained_GLA_canon: load a pretrained GLACanonForCausalLM model from a HuggingFace repo or local path with custom variant
forward_GLA_canon_causal_lm: run a forward pass through GLACanonForCausalLM with input IDs, attention mask, and optional labels
forward_GLA_block: run a forward pass through a single GLABlock with residual connections, attention, and MLP layers
